from fastapi import Depends, HTTPException, status
from fastapi.security import OAuth2PasswordBearer, OAuth2PasswordRequestForm
from jose import JWTError, jwt
from passlib.context import CryptContext
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from . import models, schemas, db

SECRET_KEY = "your_secret_key_here"
ALGORITHM = "HS256"
ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES = 30

pwd_context = CryptContext(schemes=["bcrypt"], deprecated="auto")

oauth2_scheme = OAuth2PasswordBearer(tokenUrl="token")

def verify_password(plain_password, hashed_password):
    return pwd_context.verify(plain_password, hashed_password)

def get_password_hash(password):
    return pwd_context.hash(password)

def authenticate_user(db, username: str, password: str):
    user = db.query(models.User).filter(models.User.username == username).first()
    if not user:
        return False
    if not verify_password(password, user.hashed_password):
        return False
    return user

def create_access_token(data: dict, expires_delta: timedelta = None):
    to_encode = data.copy()
    if expires_delta:
        expire = datetime.utcnow() + expires_delta
    else:
        expire = datetime.utcnow() + timedelta(minutes=15)
    to_encode.update({"exp": expire})
    encoded_jwt = jwt.encode(to_encode, SECRET_KEY, algorithm=ALGORITHM)
    return encoded_jwt

                ingredients TEXT NOT NULL,
                instructions TEXT NOT NULL,
                prep_time_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL,
                cook_time_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL,
                servings INTEGER NOT NULL,
                author_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW(),
                updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW()
            );

            ON CONFLICT (username) DO NOTHING;

package utils

import (
	"github.com/dgrijalva/jwt-go"
	"time"
)

func GenerateJWT(userID string) string {
	token := jwt.NewWithClaims(jwt.SigningMethodHS256, jwt.MapClaims{
		"sub": userID,
		"exp": time.Now().Add(time.Hour * 24 * 7).Unix(),
	})

	tokenString, _ := token.SignedString([]byte("secret"))
	return tokenString
}

  before_action :set_campaign, only: [:show, :update, :destroy]

  def index
    campaigns = Campaign.all
    render json: campaigns
  end

  def show
    render json: @campaign
  end

  def create
    campaign = current_user.campaigns.build(campaign_params)
    if campaign.save

    else
      render json: { errors: campaign.errors.full_messages }, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end

      if @campaign.update(campaign_params)

      else
        render json: { errors: @campaign.errors.full_messages }, status: :unprocessable_entity
      end
    else
      render json: { error: 'Not Authorized' }, status: :forbidden
    end
  end

    if @campaign.user_id == current_user.id

      head :no_content

    end
  end

    render json: { error: "Campaign not found" }, status: :not_found
  end

from aiohttp import web
import jwt
import datetime
from db import get_db
from passlib.context import CryptContext

JWT_SECRET = "your-secret-key"
JWT_ALGORITHM = "HS256"
TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES = 60

pwd_context = CryptContext(schemes=["bcrypt"], deprecated="auto")

async def login(request):
    data = await request.json()
    username = data.get('username')
    password = data.get('password')
    if not username or not password:
        raise web.HTTPBadRequest(text='Missing username or password')
    db = await get_db()
    async with db.execute('SELECT * FROM users WHERE username = ?', (username,)) as cursor:
        row = await cursor.fetchone()
    await db.close()
    if not row or not pwd_context.verify(password, row['password']):
        raise web.HTTPUnauthorized(text='Invalid credentials')
    payload = {
        'sub': username,
        'exp': datetime.datetime.utcnow() + datetime.timedelta(minutes=TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES)
    }
    token = jwt.encode(payload, JWT_SECRET, algorithm=JWT_ALGORITHM)
    return web.json_response({'access_token': token})

module Api
  module Controllers
    class Messages < ApplicationController
      def initialize(repo: CampaignerSMS::MessageRepository.new)
        @repo = repo
      end

      def index(env)
        req = Rack::Request.new(env)
        params = req.params
        return unauthorized_response unless current_user(env)

        page = (params['page'] || 1).to_i
        limit = (params['limit'] || 10).to_i
        filter = params['filter'] || ''

        query = @repo.all
        query = @repo.where(['content LIKE ?', "%#{filter}%"]) unless filter.empty?
        items = query.offset((page - 1) * limit).limit(limit)
        total = query.count

        messages = items.map do |m|
          {
            id: m.id,
            campaign_id: m.campaign_id,
            content: m.content,
            recipient: m.recipient,
            status: m.status,
            sent_at: m.sent_at
          }
        end

        json_response(200, { messages: messages, total: total, page: page, limit: limit })
      end

      def show(env)
        item = @repo.find(env['router.params'][:id].to_i)
        if item
          json_response(200, {
            id: item.id,
            campaign_id: item.campaign_id,
            content: item.content,
            recipient: item.recipient,
            status: item.status,
            sent_at: item.sent_at
          })
        else
          json_response(404, { error: 'Message not found' })
        end
      end

      def create(env)
        return unauthorized_response unless current_user(env)&.admin
        data = parse_json(env)

        required = %w[campaign_id content recipient]
        if required.any? { |field| data[field].to_s.strip.empty? }
          return json_response(400, error: "Missing fields: #{required.join(', ')} required")
        end

        message = CampaignerSMS::Entities::Message.new(
          campaign_id: data['campaign_id'],
          content: data['content'],
          recipient: data['recipient'],
          status: 'pending',
          sent_at: nil
        )
        @repo.create(message)
        json_response(201, { message: 'Message created' })
      end

      def update(env)
        return unauthorized_response unless current_user(env)&.admin
        id = env['router.params'][:id].to_i
        message = @repo.find(id)
        return json_response(404, error: 'Message not found') unless message

        data = parse_json(env)
        attrs = {}

        attrs[:content] = data['content'] if data['content']
        attrs[:recipient] = data['recipient'] if data['recipient']
        attrs[:status] = data['status'] if data['status']
        attrs[:sent_at] = data['sent_at'] if data['sent_at']

        message = message.dup
        attrs.each { |k, v| message[k] = v }

        @repo.update(message)
        json_response(200, { message: 'Message updated' })
      end

        return unauthorized_response unless current_user(env)&.admin

        id = env['router.params'][:id].to_i
        message = @repo.find(id)
        return json_response(404, error: 'Message not found') unless message

        @repo.delete(message)
        json_response(200, { message: 'Message deleted' })
      end
    end
  end
end

from fastapi import FastAPI, Depends, HTTPException
from fastapi.security import OAuth2PasswordBearer, OAuth2PasswordRequestForm
from passlib.context import CryptContext
from jose import JWTError, jwt
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from app.models import db_session, User

SECRET_KEY = "your_secret_key"
ALGORITHM = "HS256"
ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES = 30

oauth2_scheme = OAuth2PasswordBearer(tokenUrl="token")
pwd_context = CryptContext(schemes=["bcrypt"], deprecated="auto")

app = FastAPI()

def verify_password(plain_password, hashed_password):
    return pwd_context.verify(plain_password, hashed_password)

def get_password_hash(password):
    return pwd_context.hash(password)

def authenticate_user(username: str, password: str):
    user = User.query.filter(User.username == username).first()
    if not user:
        return False
    if not verify_password(password, user.hashed_password):
        return False
    return user

def create_access_token(data: dict, expires_delta: timedelta = None):
    to_encode = data.copy()
    if expires_delta:
        expire = datetime.utcnow() + expires_delta
    else:
        expire = datetime.utcnow() + timedelta(minutes=15)
    to_encode.update({"exp": expire})
    encoded_jwt = jwt.encode(to_encode, SECRET_KEY, algorithm=ALGORITHM)
    return encoded_jwt

@app.post("/token")
async def login(form_data: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm = Depends()):
    user = authenticate_user(form_data.username, form_data.password)
    if not user:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=400, detail="Incorrect username or password"
        )
    access_token_expires = timedelta(minutes=ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES)
    access_token = create_access_token(
        data={"sub": user.username}, expires_delta=access_token_expires
    )
    return {"access_token": access_token, "token_type": "bearer"}

from passlib.hash import bcrypt
import jwt
import datetime
from typing import Optional

async def login(request):
    data = await request.json()
    username = data.get("username")
    password = data.get("password")
    
    conn = get_db()
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    cursor.execute("SELECT * FROM users WHERE username = ?", (username,))
    user = cursor.fetchone()
    conn.close()
    
    if user and bcrypt.verify(password, user[2]):
        token = jwt.encode({"username": username, "exp": datetime.datetime.utcnow() + datetime.timedelta(hours=1)}, SECRET_KEY)
        return JSONResponse({"token": token})
    return JSONResponse({"error": "Invalid credentials"}, status_code=401)

    data = await request.json()
    username = data.get("username")
    password = data.get("password")
    
    password_hash = bcrypt.hash(password)
    conn = get_db()
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    try:
        cursor.execute("INSERT INTO users (username, password_hash) VALUES (?, ?)", (username, password_hash))

        conn.close()
        return JSONResponse({"message": "User registered"})

        return JSONResponse({"error": "Username taken"}, status_code=400)

        try:
            payload = jwt.decode(token.split(" ")[1], SECRET_KEY, algorithms=["HS256"])
        except:
            return JSONResponse({"error": "Invalid token"}, status_code=401)
        request.state.user = payload["username"]
        return await func(request, *args, **kwargs)
    return wrapper

from flask import Blueprint, jsonify, request
from flask_jwt_extended import jwt_required, get_jwt_identity
from models import db
from schemas import WeatherDataSchema

admin_bp = Blueprint('admin', __name__)

@admin_bp.route('/stats', methods=['GET'])
@jwt_required()
def get_admin_stats():
    current_user = get_jwt_identity()
    if not current_user.get('is_admin'):
        return jsonify({"msg": "Administration rights required"}), 403
    
    total_users = db.session.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users").scalar_one()
    total_weather_records = db.session.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM weather_data").scalar_one()
    
    return jsonify({
        "total_users": total_users,
        "total_weather_records": total_weather_records
    })

@admin_bp.route('/reset-password', methods=['POST'])
@jwt_required()
def reset_user_password():
    current_user = get_jwt_identity()
    if not current_user.get('is_admin'):
        return jsonify({"msg": "Administration rights required"}), 403

    data = request.get_json()
    username_to_reset = data.get('username')
    new_password = data.get('new_password')

    if not username_to_reset or not new_password:
        return jsonify({"msg": "Username and new password are required"}), 400
    
    from models import User
    user_to_reset = User.query.filter_by(username=username_to_reset).first()
    if not user_to_reset:
        return jsonify({"msg": "User not found"}), 404
        
if django.contrib.auth.password_validation.validate_password(new_password, user=user_to_reset):
        user_to_reset.set_password(new_password)
    db.session.commit()
    
    return jsonify({"msg": f"Password for user {username_to_reset} has been reset."}), 200

from starlette.routing import Route, Mount
from starlette.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware
from strawberry.asgi import GraphQL

from . import db, auth
from .schema import schema


async def health(request):
    return JSONResponse({"status": "ok"})


async def root(request):
    return PlainTextResponse("WeatherDash GraphQL API. See /api/graphql for GraphiQL UI.")


async def get_context(request):
    user = auth.get_user_from_request(request)
    return {"request": request, "user": user}


graphql_app = GraphQL(schema, graphiql=True, context_getter=get_context)

routes = [
    Route("/", endpoint=root, methods=["GET"]),
    Route("/health", endpoint=health, methods=["GET"]),
    Mount("/api/graphql", graphql_app),
]

app = Starlette(routes=routes)

# Allow same-origin via Nginx; optionally broaden if needed
app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=["*"],
    allow_methods=["GET", "POST", "OPTIONS"],
    allow_headers=["*"],
)


@app.on_event("startup")
async def on_startup():
    db.init_db()
    auth.ensure_admin_seed()

from fastapi import Depends, HTTPException, status
from fastapi.security import OAuth2PasswordBearer, OAuth2PasswordRequestForm
from passlib.context import CryptContext
from jose import JWTError, jwt
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from pydantic import BaseModel
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
from .db import SessionLocal, Base
from . import models

SECRET_KEY = "your_secret_key"
ALGORITHM = "HS256"
ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES = 30

pwd_context = CryptContext(schemes=["bcrypt"], deprecated="auto")

oauth2_scheme = OAuth2PasswordBearer(tokenUrl="token")

class Token(BaseModel):
    access_token: str
    token_type: str

def verify_password(plain_password, hashed_password):
    return pwd_context.verify(plain_password, hashed_password)

def get_password_hash(password):
    return pwd_context.hash(password)

def authenticate_user(db: Session, username: str, password: str):
    user = db.query(models.User).filter(models.User.username == username).first()
    if not user or not verify_password(password, user.hashed_password):
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
            detail="Incorrect username or password",
            headers={"WWW-Authenticate": "Bearer"},
        )
    return user

def create_access_token(data: dict, expires_delta: timedelta = None):
    to_encode = data.copy()
    if expires_delta:
        expire = datetime.utcnow() + expires_delta
    else:
        expire = datetime.utcnow() + timedelta(minutes=15)
    to_encode.update({"exp": expire})
    encoded_jwt = jwt.encode(to_encode, SECRET_KEY, algorithm=ALGORITHM)
    return encoded_jwt

def get_current_user(token: str = Depends(oauth2_scheme), db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    credentials_exception = HTTPException(
        status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
        detail="Could not validate credentials",
        headers={"WWW-Authenticate": "Bearer"},
    )
    try:
        payload = jwt.decode(token, SECRET_KEY, algorithms=[ALGORITHM])
        username: str = payload.get("sub")
        if username is None:
            raise credentials_exception
    except JWTError:
        raise credentials_exception
    user = db.query(models.User).filter(models.User.username == username).first()
    if user is None:
        raise credentials_exception
    return user

# Use the official PHP image as a base
FROM php:8.1-apache

# Set working directory
WORKDIR /var/www/html

# Install Composer
COPY --from=composer:latest /usr/bin/composer /usr/bin/composer

# Install PHP extensions required by Laminas and JWT
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
    unzip \
    libsqlite3-dev \
    && docker-php-ext-install pdo pdo_sqlite

# Enable Apache rewrite module
RUN a2enmod rewrite

# Copy application files
COPY . .

# Install Composer dependencies
RUN COMPOSER_ALLOW_SUPERUSER=1 composer install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader

# Create data directory and set permissions for SQLite database
# The data directory should be outside webroot in a real scenario,
# but for a simple docker setup, we place it here and mount a volume.
RUN mkdir -p data && chmod -R 777 data

# Expose port (Apache listens on 80 by default)
EXPOSE 80

# The default command for php:8.1-apache will start Apache
# Command is defined in docker-compose.yml to ensure correct apache start (for debugging if needed)
CMD ["apache2-foreground"]

import jwt
import datetime

SECRET_KEY = "supersecretkey"

def generate_token(user):
    exp = datetime.datetime.utcnow() + datetime.timedelta(hours=2)
    payload = {"sub": user["id"], "username": user["username"], "role": user["role"], "exp": exp}
    return jwt.encode(payload, SECRET_KEY, algorithm="HS256")

def decode_token(token):
    payload = jwt.decode(token, SECRET_KEY, algorithms=["HS256"])
    return {"id": payload["sub"], "username": payload["username"], "role": payload["role"]}

    end
    
    workouts.map(&:to_hash).to_json

      return { error: 'Workout not found' }.to_json
    end
    
    unless current_user.admin? || workout.user_id == current_user.id

      return { error: 'Forbidden' }.to_json
    end

      duration: data['duration'],
      calories_burned: data['calories_burned'],
      performed_at: data['performed_at']

    if workout.save

      workout.to_hash.to_json
    else
      status 400
      { error: 'Failed to create workout' }.to_json

    end

from aiohttp import web
import secrets

# Simple token-based authentication
# In a real app, you'd use JWT or OAuth
API_TOKENS = {
    "user1": "eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjoidXNlcjEifQ"
}

async def auth_middleware(app: web.Application, handler):
    async def middleware_handler(request):
        # Skip auth for swagger
        if request.path.startswith('/swagger') or request.path == '/':
            return await handler(request)
            
        auth_header = request.headers.get('Authorization')
        if not auth_header or not auth_header.startswith('Bearer '):
            return web.json_response({'error': 'Missing or invalid authorization header'}, status=401)
        
        token = auth_header.split(' ')[1]
        user_id = None
        
        for uid, api_token in API_TOKENS.items():
            if secrets.compare_digest(token, api_token):
                user_id = uid
                break
        
        if not user_id:
            return web.json_response({'error': 'Invalid token'}, status=401)
        
        request['user_id'] = user_id
        return await handler(request)
    
    return middleware_handler

def setup_auth(app: web.Application):
    app.middlewares.append(auth_middleware)

class AuthenticationController < ApplicationController
  skip_before_action :authenticate_request

  def register
    user = User.new(user_params)
    if user.save
      token = jwt_encode(user_id: user.id)
      render json: { token: token, user: { id: user.id, email: user.email, role: user.role } }, status: :created
    else
      render json: { errors: user.errors.full_messages }, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end

  def login
    user = User.find_by(email: params[:email])
    if user&.authenticate(params[:password])
      token = jwt_encode(user_id: user.id)
      render json: { token: token, user: { id: user.id, email: user.email, role: user.role } }
    else
      render json: { error: 'Invalid credentials' }, status: :unauthorized
    end
  end

  private

  def user_params
    params.permit(:email, :password, :role)
  end

  def jwt_encode(payload)
    JWT.encode(payload, Rails.application.secret_key_base, 'HS256')
  end
end

                Folder.all
              else
                current_user.folders
              end

  end

  def show
    render json: folder_response(@folder)
  end

    folder = current_user.folders.new(folder_params)
    if folder.save

    else
      render json: { errors: folder.errors.full_messages }, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end

  def update
    if @folder.update(folder_params)
      render json: folder_response(@folder)

    end
  end

  end

    authorize_write!(@folder)

    authorize_delete!(@folder)

class JWTAuth
  SECRET_KEY = ENV['JWT_SECRET'] || 'your-secret-key-change-in-production'
  ALGORITHM = 'HS256'

  def self.encode(payload)
    JWT.encode(payload, SECRET_KEY, ALGORITHM)
  end

  def self.decode(token)
    JWT.decode(token, SECRET_KEY, true, { algorithm: ALGORITHM })[0]
  rescue JWT::DecodeError
    nil

    auth_header = request.env['HTTP_AUTHORIZATION']

  end

# Change current user to www
USER www-data

# Install dependencies
RUN composer install --optimize-autoloader --no-dev

# Revert to nonroot user for final commands
RUN adduser -D -g "" nonroot
USER nonroot

# Expose port
EXPOSE 9000

# Set entrypoint
COPY docker/entrypoint.sh /usr/local/bin/entrypoint.sh
RUN chmod +x /usr/local/bin/entrypoint.sh
ENTRYPOINT ["/usr/local/bin/entrypoint.sh"]

# Start PHP-FPM
CMD ["php-fpm"]
